title: Massachusetts pharmacy MassPAT dispensing-data reporting
rule_summary: Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard.
exam_relevance: The rule distinguishes federally controlled drugs from Massachusetts additional monitored drugs and tests reporting status without changing federal schedule.

authority.name: Massachusetts PMP Data Submission Guide for Dispensers

numeric_facts.conditions: Covered dispensing transaction under the current dispenser guide

exceptions: 105 CMR 700.012 contains setting- and transaction-specific exclusions that must be checked before applying the general reporting rule.
common_confusions: Gabapentin reporting does not make gabapentin federally scheduled.
Massachusetts Schedule VI drugs generally are not all MassPAT-reportable; gabapentin is specifically designated.
verification_notes: Regulation and current official dispenser guide checked together on 2026-08-13.
